translations.literal: Ranks of inner-court consorts with noble titles.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks of Inner-Court Consorts with Noble Titles.

sentences.zh: 元妃、貴妃、淑妃、德妃、賢妃，正一品。

translations.literal: Primary Consort, Noble Consort, Virtuous Consort, Moral Consort, and Worthy Consort — senior first rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Primary Consort, Noble Consort, Virtuous Consort, Moral Consort, and Worthy Consort all held the senior first rank.

sentences.zh: 昭儀、昭容、昭媛、修儀、修容、修媛、充儀、充容、充媛曰九嬪，正二品。

translations.literal: Shining Lady, Shining Beauty, Shining Maid; Cultivated Lady, Cultivated Beauty, Cultivated Maid; and Fulfilling Lady, Fulfilling Beauty, Fulfilling Maid — called the Nine Consorts — senior second rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Shining, Cultivated, and Fulfilling ladies, beauties, and maids — nine offices in all, styled the Nine Consorts — held the senior second rank.

translations.literal: Talented Lady — senior third rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Talented Lady held the senior third rank.

translations.literal: Beautiful Lady — senior fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Beautiful Lady held the senior fourth rank.

translations.literal: Accomplished Lady — senior fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Accomplished Lady held the senior fifth rank.

translations.literal: Nine posts for each, called the Twenty-Seven Hereditary Consorts.
translations.idiomatic: There were nine holders of each title, together styled the Twenty-Seven Hereditary Consorts.

translations.literal: Treasured Companion — senior sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Treasured Companion held the senior sixth rank.

translations.literal: Imperial Maid — senior seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Maid held the senior seventh rank.

translations.literal: Selected Maid — senior eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Selected Maid held the senior eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 各二十七員，曰八十一禦妻。

translations.literal: Twenty-seven posts for each, called the Eighty-One Imperial Wives.
translations.idiomatic: There were twenty-seven holders of each title, together styled the Eighty-One Imperial Wives.

sentences.zh: 按金格，貞祐後之制，貴妃下有真妃，淑妃下有麗妃、柔妃，而無德妃、賢妃。

translations.literal: According to Jin statutes, under the regulations after the Zhenyou era, below Noble Consort there was True Consort; below Virtuous Consort there were Graceful Consort and Gentle Consort; but there were no Moral Consort or Worthy Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Jin code as revised after the Zhenyou period, the Noble Consort was followed by the True Consort rather than the Moral or Worthy Consort, while the Virtuous Consort was followed by the Graceful and Gentle Consorts.

translations.literal: The Nine Consorts were the same.
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Consorts followed the same pattern of revision.

sentences.zh: 婕妤下有麗人、才人為正三品。

translations.literal: Below Talented Lady were Graceful Lady and Accomplished Lady as senior third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Below the Talented Lady, the Graceful Lady and Accomplished Lady held the senior third rank.

sentences.zh: 順儀、淑華、淑儀為正四品。

translations.literal: Compliant Lady, Cultivated Splendor, and Cultivated Ceremony were senior fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Compliant Lady, Cultivated Splendor, and Cultivated Ceremony held the senior fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 尚宮夫人，尚宮左夫人、尚宮右夫人、宮正夫人、寶華夫人、尚儀夫人、尚服夫人、尚寢夫人、欽聖夫人、資明夫人為正五品。

translations.literal: Chief of Palace Affairs Lady, Left Chief of Palace Affairs Lady, Right Chief of Palace Affairs Lady, Palace Rectitude Lady, Treasured Splendor Lady, Chief of Ceremonies Lady, Chief of Wardrobe Lady, Chief of Quarters Lady, Revered Sage Lady, and Supporting Wisdom Lady — senior fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief of Palace Affairs Lady and her left and right deputies, together with the Palace Rectitude, Treasured Splendor, Ceremonies, Wardrobe, Quarters, Revered Sage, and Supporting Wisdom Ladies, all held the senior fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 尚儀禦侍、尚服禦侍、尚寢禦侍、尚正禦侍、寶符宸侍、奉恩令人、奉光令人、奉徽令人、奉美令人為正六品，司正禦侍、寶符禦侍、司儀禦侍、司符禦侍，司寢禦侍、司飾禦侍、司設禦侍、司衣禦侍、司膳禦侍、司藥禦侍、仙韶使、光訓良侍、明訓良侍、遵訓良侍、從訓良侍為正七品。

translations.literal: Ceremonies Imperial Attendant, Wardrobe Imperial Attendant, Quarters Imperial Attendant, Rectitude Imperial Attendant, Talisman Inner Attendant, Favor-Bestowing Lady, Radiance-Bestowing Lady, Emblem-Bestowing Lady, and Beauty-Bestowing Lady — senior sixth rank; Rectitude Director Imperial Attendant, Talisman Director Imperial Attendant, Ceremonies Director Imperial Attendant, Talisman Director Imperial Attendant, Quarters Director Imperial Attendant, Adornment Director Imperial Attendant, Furnishings Director Imperial Attendant, Garments Director Imperial Attendant, Provisions Director Imperial Attendant, Pharmacy Director Imperial Attendant, Immortal Harmony Commissioner, Radiant Instruction Good Attendant, Bright Instruction Good Attendant, Observant Instruction Good Attendant, and Following Instruction Good Attendant — senior seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Ceremonies, Wardrobe, Quarters, and Rectitude Imperial Attendants, the Talisman Inner Attendant, and the four Bestowing Ladies held the senior sixth rank; the various Director Imperial Attendants, the Immortal Harmony Commissioner, and the four Instruction Good Attendants held the senior seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 典儀禦侍、典膳禦侍、典寢禦侍、典飾禦侍、典設禦侍、典衣禦侍、典藥禦侍、仙韶副使、承和良侍、承惠良侍、承宜良侍為正八品。

translations.literal: Ceremonies Superintendent Imperial Attendant, Provisions Superintendent Imperial Attendant, Quarters Superintendent Imperial Attendant, Adornment Superintendent Imperial Attendant, Furnishings Superintendent Imperial Attendant, Garments Superintendent Imperial Attendant, Pharmacy Superintendent Imperial Attendant, Deputy Immortal Harmony Commissioner, Harmonious Reception Good Attendant, Gracious Reception Good Attendant, and Suitable Reception Good Attendant — senior eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Ceremonies, Provisions, Quarters, Adornment, Furnishings, Garments, and Pharmacy Superintendent Imperial Attendants, the Deputy Immortal Harmony Commissioner, and the three Reception Good Attendants held the senior eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 掌儀禦侍、掌服禦侍、掌寢禦侍、掌飾禦侍、掌設禦侍、掌衣禦侍、掌膳禦侍、掌藥禦侍、仙韶掌音、祗肅良侍、祗敬良侍、祗願良侍為正九品。

translations.literal: Ceremonies Manager Imperial Attendant, Wardrobe Manager Imperial Attendant, Quarters Manager Imperial Attendant, Adornment Manager Imperial Attendant, Furnishings Manager Imperial Attendant, Garments Manager Imperial Attendant, Provisions Manager Imperial Attendant, Pharmacy Manager Imperial Attendant, Immortal Harmony Music Keeper, Reverent Solemnity Good Attendant, Reverent Respect Good Attendant, and Reverent Aspiration Good Attendant — senior ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Ceremonies, Wardrobe, Quarters, Adornment, Furnishings, Garments, Provisions, and Pharmacy Manager Imperial Attendants, the Immortal Harmony Music Keeper, and the three Reverent Good Attendants held the senior ninth rank.

translations.literal: Ranks of palace women's official posts.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks and Posts of Palace Women with Official Duties.

translations.literal: All followed the Tang system.
translations.idiomatic: These offices all followed the Tang system.

sentences.zh: 尚宮二人，掌導引皇后，管司記、司言、司簿、司闈，仍總知五尚須物出納等事。

translations.literal: Two Chiefs of Palace Affairs, who guided and attended the empress, supervised the Directors of Records, Speech, Registers, and Gates, and also oversaw overall receipt and disbursement of supplies required by the Five Chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Two Chiefs of Palace Affairs guided the empress and supervised the directors of records, speech, registers, and gates, while also overseeing the receipt and issue of all supplies needed by the five chief bureaus.

sentences.zh: 司記二人、典記二人、掌記二人，掌在內諸文書出入目錄，為記審訖付行縣印等事。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Records, two Superintendents of Records, and two Managers of Records, who managed inward documents' incoming and outgoing registers, reviewed entries, and forwarded them for stamping and dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors, two superintendents, and two managers of records kept registers of all inward documents, reviewed them on completion, and forwarded them for stamping and dispatch.

translations.literal: Six female clerks, who managed duty documents and registers.
translations.idiomatic: Six female clerks maintained the duty registers.

sentences.zh: 司言二人、典言二人、掌言二人、女史四人，掌宣傳啟奏之事。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Speech, two Superintendents of Speech, two Managers of Speech, and four female clerks, who managed announcements, transmissions, and memorial presentations.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors, two superintendents, and two managers of speech, with four female clerks, handled announcements, transmissions, and presentations to the throne.

sentences.zh: 司簿二人、典簿二人、掌簿二人、女史六人，掌宮人名簿廩賜之事。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Registers, two Superintendents of Registers, two Managers of Registers, and six female clerks, who managed palace women's name registers and grain stipends.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors, two superintendents, and two managers of registers, with six female clerks, kept the name rolls of palace women and their grain stipends.

sentences.zh: 司闈六人、典闈六人、掌闈六人、女史四人，掌宮闈管鑰之事。

translations.literal: Six Directors of Gates, six Superintendents of Gates, six Managers of Gates, and four female clerks, who managed palace gate keys.
translations.idiomatic: Six directors, six superintendents, and six managers of gates, with four female clerks, held charge of the palace gate keys.

sentences.zh: 尚儀二人，掌禮儀起居、管司籍、司樂、司賓、司贊事。

translations.literal: Two Chiefs of Ceremonies, who managed ritual, daily conduct, and the Directors of Archives, Music, Guests, and Acclamation.
translations.idiomatic: Two Chiefs of Ceremonies oversaw ritual and daily conduct and supervised the directors of archives, music, guests, and acclamation.

sentences.zh: 司籍二人、典籍二人、掌籍二人、女史十人，掌經籍教學紙筆幾案之事。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Archives, two Archivists, two Managers of Archives, and ten female clerks, who managed classics, instruction, paper, brushes, and writing desks.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors and two managers of archives, two archivists, and ten female clerks were charged with the classics, instruction, stationery, and writing desks.

sentences.zh: 司樂四人、典樂四人、掌樂四人、女史二人，掌音樂之事。

translations.literal: Four Directors of Music, four Superintendents of Music, four Managers of Music, and two female clerks, who managed music.
translations.idiomatic: Four directors, four superintendents, and four managers of music, with two female clerks, handled all musical affairs.

sentences.zh: 司賓二人、典賓二人、掌賓二人、女史二人，掌賓客參見、朝會引導之事。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Guests, two Superintendents of Guests, two Managers of Guests, and two female clerks, who managed guest audiences and court-session guidance.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors, two superintendents, and two managers of guests, with two female clerks, directed guest audiences and guided participants at court sessions.

sentences.zh: 司贊二人、典贊二人、掌贊二人、女史二人、彤史二人，掌禮儀班序、設板贊拜之事。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Acclamation, two Superintendents of Acclamation, two Managers of Acclamation, two female clerks, and two vermilion clerks, who managed ritual formation order and setting boards for acclamation and obeisance.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors, two superintendents, and two managers of acclamation, with two female clerks and two vermilion clerks, arranged ritual formations and set the boards for acclamation and obeisance.

sentences.zh: 尚服二人，掌管司寶、司衣、司飾、司仗之事。

translations.literal: Two Chiefs of Wardrobe, who supervised the Directors of Treasures, Garments, Adornment, and Arms.
translations.idiomatic: Two Chiefs of Wardrobe supervised the directors of treasures, garments, adornment, and arms.

sentences.zh: 司寶二人、典寶二人、掌寶二人、女史四人，掌珍寶符契圖籍之事。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Treasures, two Superintendents of Treasures, two Managers of Treasures, and four female clerks, who managed precious objects, tallies, and illustrated registers.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors, two superintendents, and two managers of treasures, with four female clerks, kept the precious objects, tallies, and illustrated registers.

sentences.zh: 司衣二人、典衣二人、掌衣二人、女史四人，掌禦衣服首飾之事。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Garments, two Superintendents of Garments, two Managers of Garments, and four female clerks, who managed imperial garments and head ornaments.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors, two superintendents, and two managers of garments, with four female clerks, were in charge of imperial clothing and head ornaments.

sentences.zh: 司飾二人、典飾二人、掌飾二人、女史二人，掌膏沐巾櫛服玩之事。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Adornment, two Superintendents of Adornment, two Managers of Adornment, and two female clerks, who managed cosmetics, bathing, towels, combs, and ornamental dress.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors, two superintendents, and two managers of adornment, with two female clerks, supplied cosmetics, bathing goods, towels, combs, and ornamental dress.

sentences.zh: 司仗二人、典仗二人、掌仗二人、女史二人，掌仗衛兵器之事。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Arms, two Superintendents of Arms, two Managers of Arms, and two female clerks, who managed escort guards and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors, two superintendents, and two managers of arms, with two female clerks, oversaw the escort guard and its weapons.

sentences.zh: 尚食二人，掌知禦膳、進食先嘗，管司膳、司醖、司藥、司饎事。

translations.literal: Two Chiefs of Provisions, who supervised imperial meals, tasted food before it was served, and managed the Directors of Provisions, Brewing, Pharmacy, and Rations.
translations.idiomatic: Two Chiefs of Provisions oversaw the imperial table, tasted food before it was served, and supervised the directors of provisions, brewing, pharmacy, and rations.

sentences.zh: 司膳四人、典膳四人、掌膳四人、女史四人，掌膳羞器皿。

translations.literal: Four Directors of Provisions, four Superintendents of Provisions, four Managers of Provisions, and four female clerks, who managed dishes, delicacies, and vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Four directors, four superintendents, and four managers of provisions, with four female clerks, handled dishes, delicacies, and serving vessels.

sentences.zh: 司醖二人、典醖二人、掌醖二人、女史二人，掌酒醴。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Brewing, two Superintendents of Brewing, two Managers of Brewing, and two female clerks, who managed wine and fermented beverages.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors, two superintendents, and two managers of brewing, with two female clerks, were in charge of wine and fermented beverages.

sentences.zh: 司藥二人、典藥二人、掌藥二人、女史二人，掌醫藥。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Pharmacy, two Superintendents of Pharmacy, two Managers of Pharmacy, and two female clerks, who managed medicine.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors, two superintendents, and two managers of pharmacy, with two female clerks, handled medical supplies and treatment.

sentences.zh: 司饎二人、典饎二人、掌饎二人，女史二人，掌宮人食並柴炭之事。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Rations, two Superintendents of Rations, two Managers of Rations, and two female clerks, who managed palace women's food and fuel.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors, two superintendents, and two managers of rations, with two female clerks, supplied food and fuel to the palace women.

sentences.zh: 尚寢二人，管司設、司輿、司苑、司燈事。

translations.literal: Two Chiefs of Quarters, who supervised the Directors of Furnishings, Carriages, Gardens, and Lamps.
translations.idiomatic: Two Chiefs of Quarters supervised the directors of furnishings, carriages, gardens, and lamps.

sentences.zh: 司設二人、典設二人、掌設二人、女史二人，掌帷帳、床褥、枕席、灑掃、鋪設。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Furnishings, two Superintendents of Furnishings, two Managers of Furnishings, and two female clerks, who managed curtains, bedding, pillows, mats, sweeping, and arrangement.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors, two superintendents, and two managers of furnishings, with two female clerks, cared for curtains, bedding, pillows, mats, sweeping, and room arrangement.

sentences.zh: 司輿二人、典輿二人、掌輿二人、女史二人，掌輿傘扇羽儀。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Carriages, two Superintendents of Carriages, two Managers of Carriages, and two female clerks, who managed litters, umbrellas, fans, and feather insignia.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors, two superintendents, and two managers of carriages, with two female clerks, maintained litters, umbrellas, fans, and feather insignia.

sentences.zh: 司苑二人、典苑二人、掌苑二人、女史二人，掌苑囿種植蔬果。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Gardens, two Superintendents of Gardens, two Managers of Gardens, and two female clerks, who managed parklands, planting, and fruits and vegetables.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors, two superintendents, and two managers of gardens, with two female clerks, tended the parklands and their plantings of fruit and vegetables.

sentences.zh: 司燈二人、典燈二人、掌燈二人、女史二人，掌燈油火燭。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Lamps, two Superintendents of Lamps, two Managers of Lamps, and two female clerks, who managed lamp oil, fire, and candles.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors, two superintendents, and two managers of lamps, with two female clerks, supplied lamp oil, fire, and candles.

sentences.zh: 尚功二人，掌女功，管司制、司珍、司彩、司計事。

translations.literal: Two Chiefs of Works, who managed women's crafts and supervised the Directors of Manufacture, Treasures, Colors, and Accounts.
translations.idiomatic: Two Chiefs of Works oversaw women's crafts and supervised the directors of manufacture, treasures, colors, and accounts.

sentences.zh: 司制二人、典制二人、掌制二人、女史二人，掌裁縫衣服篡組之事。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Manufacture, two Superintendents of Manufacture, two Managers of Manufacture, and two female clerks, who managed cutting, sewing garments, and weaving.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors, two superintendents, and two managers of manufacture, with two female clerks, handled cutting, sewing, and weaving.

sentences.zh: 司珍二人、典珍二人、掌珍二人、女史二人，掌金珠玉寶財貨之事。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Treasures, two Superintendents of Treasures, two Managers of Treasures, and two female clerks, who managed gold, pearls, jade, precious objects, and valuables.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors, two superintendents, and two managers of treasures, with two female clerks, kept the gold, pearls, jade, and other valuables.

sentences.zh: 司彩二人、典彩二人、掌彩二人、女史二人，掌錦文緋彩絲帛之事。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Colors, two Superintendents of Colors, two Managers of Colors, and two female clerks, who managed brocade patterns, crimson dyes, and silk fabrics.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors, two superintendents, and two managers of colors, with two female clerks, were in charge of brocade patterns, crimson dyes, and silk fabrics.

sentences.zh: 司計二人、典計二人、掌計二人、女史二人，掌支度衣服飲食柴炭雜物之事。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Accounts, two Superintendents of Accounts, two Managers of Accounts, and two female clerks, who managed disbursement of clothing, food, fuel, and miscellaneous goods.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors, two superintendents, and two managers of accounts, with two female clerks, disbursed clothing, food, fuel, and miscellaneous supplies.

sentences.zh: 宮正二人，掌總知宮內格式、糾正推罰之事。

translations.literal: Two Palace Rectifiers, who overall supervised inner-palace regulations and correction, impeachment, and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Two Palace Rectifiers had overall charge of inner-palace regulations and of correction, impeachment, and punishment.

translations.literal: Two Directors of Rectitude, who shared the same duties.
translations.idiomatic: Two Directors of Rectitude shared the same authority.

translations.literal: Two Superintendents of Rectitude, who investigated violations.
translations.idiomatic: Two Superintendents of Rectitude investigated breaches of rule.

translations.literal: Four female clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Four female clerks assisted them.

sentences.zh: 皇后位下女職依隆慶宮所設人數，大安元年定。

translations.literal: Women's posts below the empress followed the staffing numbers set for Longqing Palace, fixed in the first year of Da'an.
translations.idiomatic: The women's posts under the empress followed the staffing established for Longqing Palace, fixed in the first year of the Da'an reign.

translations.literal: One Director of Inner Chambers — eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Director of Inner Chambers held the eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 掌宮內諸事並給散宮人俸給食料。

translations.literal: She managed all inner-palace affairs and distributed palace women's salaries and food supplies.
translations.idiomatic: She managed all inner-palace affairs and disbursed the salaries and food rations of the palace women.

translations.literal: One Upholder of Ceremonies — eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Upholder of Ceremonies held the eighth rank.

translations.literal: One Assistant of Ceremonies — ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant of Ceremonies held the ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 掌左右給事、宣傳啟奏、經籍紙筆之事。

translations.literal: They managed left and right attendants, announcements and memorial presentations, and classics, paper, and brushes.
translations.idiomatic: They supervised the attendants on the left and right, handled announcements and presentations to the throne, and kept the classics, paper, and brushes.

sentences.zh: 直閣一員、司陳一員，九品。

translations.literal: One Attendant of the Pavilion and one Director of Arrangement — ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Attendant of the Pavilion and one Director of Arrangement held the ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 掌帳幕床褥輿傘、灑掃鋪陳、薪炭燈燭之事。

translations.literal: They managed curtains, bedding, litters, umbrellas, sweeping, arrangement, fuel, and lamps and candles.
translations.idiomatic: They cared for curtains, bedding, litters, and umbrellas, handled sweeping and room arrangement, and supplied fuel, lamps, and candles.

sentences.zh: 秉衣一員、奉衣一員，九品。

translations.literal: One Upholder of Garments and one Provider of Garments — ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Upholder of Garments and one Provider of Garments held the ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 掌首飾衣服器玩諸寶財貨，裁制縑彩之事。

translations.literal: They managed head ornaments, garments, vessels, curios, precious objects, valuables, and cutting and dyeing silk fabrics.

translations.idiomatic: He separately administered tribal villages and stockaded hamlets.

sentences.zh: 司吏，女直一人、漢人一人。

translations.literal: Clerks: one Jurchen and one Han.
translations.idiomatic: There were one Jurchen clerk and one Han clerk.

sentences.zh: 習尼昆，掌本颭差役等事，撻馬。

translations.literal: Versed in the Nikun, in charge of corvée assignments for this ban and related matters, and runners.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks versed in the Nikun handled corvée for the ban and related matters; there were also runners.

sentences.zh: 右土魯渾部族南北移裏堇司依此置。

translations.literal: The Northern and Southern Yilijin Offices of the Turghun tribal group were established according to this.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern and Southern Yilijin Offices of the Turghun tribal group followed this establishment.

sentences.zh: 部羅火部族左右移裏堇司置女直司吏一人。

translations.literal: The Left and Right Yilijin Offices of the Borluo Fire tribal group each had one Jurchen office clerk.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Yilijin Offices of the Borluo Fire tribal group each had one Jurchen office clerk.

translations.literal: Various Tulü.
translations.idiomatic: Various Tulü.

translations.literal: One tulü at junior seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: One tulü held the junior seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 掌部落詞訟、防察違背等事。

translations.literal: In charge of tribal lawsuits and guarding against violations.
translations.idiomatic: He handled tribal lawsuits and guarded against violations.

sentences.zh: 女直司吏一人，通事一人。

translations.literal: One Jurchen office clerk and one interpreter.

translations.idiomatic: One Commissioner Supervising All Urugu held the senior fourth rank.

translations.literal: Established in the fourth year of Mingchang.

sentences.zh: 是年以安遠大將軍尚廄局使石抹貞兼慶州刺史為之，設女直司吏三人，譯一人，通事一人。

translations.idiomatic: That year An'yuan Grand General and Imperial Stud Bureau Commissioner Shimozhen was appointed concurrently prefect of Qing Prefecture, with three Jurchen office clerks, one translator, and one interpreter.

translations.idiomatic: One Commissioner held the junior fourth rank.

translations.literal: One Deputy Commissioner at junior sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Deputy Commissioner held the junior sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 掌檢校群牧畜養蕃息之事。

translations.literal: In charge of inspecting herd pasturage, raising livestock, and increasing their numbers.
translations.idiomatic: He inspected herd pasturage, raised livestock, and increased their numbers.

translations.literal: One Adjudicator at senior eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Adjudicator held the senior eighth rank.

translations.literal: In charge of signing and adjudicating this office's business.
translations.idiomatic: He signed and adjudicated this office's business.

translations.literal: One Legal Specialist at junior eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Legal Specialist held the junior eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 女直司吏四人，譯人一人，撻馬十六人，使八人，副五人，判三人。

translations.literal: Four Jurchen office clerks, one translator, sixteen runners—eight for commissioners, five for deputies, three for adjudicators.
translations.idiomatic: There were four Jurchen office clerks, one translator, and sixteen runners: eight for commissioners, five for deputies, and three for adjudicators.

sentences.zh: 又設埽穩脫朵，分掌諸畜，所謂牛馬群子也。

translations.literal: Saowen tuoduo were also established to administer the various herds—the so-called cattle and horse droves.
translations.idiomatic: Saowen tuoduo were also established to administer the various herds—the cattle-and-horse droves.

sentences.zh: 惟板底因、烏解、忒恩、蒲鮮群牧依此置。

translations.literal: Only the Bandiyin, Wujie, Te'en, and Puxian herd-pasturage offices were established according to this.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Bandiyin, Wujie, Te'en, and Puxian herd-pasturage offices followed this establishment.
